dict.string: Dropzone reads your Downloads folder to show, sort and clean up the files in it. Nothing leaves this Mac.
Dropzone reads your Desktop to show, sort and clean up the files on it. Nothing leaves this Mac.
Dropzone reads your Documents folder to show, sort and clean up the files in it. Nothing leaves this Mac.
Dropzone reads folders you add from external drives to show, sort and clean up the files in them.
Dropzone reads folders you add from network drives to show, sort and clean up the files in them.
